title: John Harbaugh defends conservative Giants play-calling for ‘capable’ J.J. McCarthy

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh defends conservative Giants play-calling for ‘capable’ J.J. McCarthy
sources.description: The box score reads that last Thursday was the most prolific passing night of J.J. McCarthy’s young career. The fourth quarter of the Giants’ loss to the Commanders suggests something very different.
